A Creative Intelligence Company

We build things
that live.

Not a production house. Not an AI studio. Not a digital agency. Those are capabilities — they are not the category. Bad Blood is an organism for turning a problem into something the world can feel, use, remember and grow with.

01 — The Shift

What needs
to happen?

Every brief arrives already answered. A video. A website. A campaign. The answer is stated before the problem is, and the work spends its life defending a format nobody examined. So the first question here is not what you want made.

OldWhat do you want us to make?
HereWhat needs to happen?

The problem chooses the idea. The idea chooses the medium.

has an anatomy.

03 — The Living Loop

Nothing lives alone.
It enters culture.

The work should not die when the files are delivered. It is released into an environment that answers back. What the answer leaves behind is the only result worth measuring — and it is what the next version is built from.

ProblemDNABlood SkinCultureScar Learning↺ DNA

Culture is the environment the work enters. Scar is the lasting change it leaves behind. Learning feeds the next version of the organism.

We don't follow culture.
We leave scars on it.

04 — Work becomes scars

Don't show what we made.
Show what changed.

Filed by medium, a portfolio argues that the medium came first. These are filed by anatomy instead — what intelligence shaped it, what made people care, how they met it.

Concept films are self-initiated work. They were not commissioned by the brands shown.

05 — IRIS

She wasn't hired.
She was built.

IRIS is the intelligence interface of Bad Blood — not a support bot bolted to the corner of a website. She reads the problem before the deliverable, keeps what the company has learned, and is the reason the claim about building intelligent systems does not have to be believed. You are already using one.

You feel IRIS before you see IRIS.

Same identity. Different clearance: PublicClientTeamCore

Public IRIS holds no credentials, no client memory and no privileged tools. That is enforced by what the key opens, not by asking her nicely.

06 — Bad Blood Originals

Clients are not the only
source of ideas.

Things we make because they should exist. Owned characters, worlds, films and intelligences — and when one of them becomes a product, a platform or a business, Bad Blood can be its builder and its owner rather than its agency.

We don't only build for companies. We can build companies.

07 — The Company

Intelligence without taste is just noise.

One brief. One brain. Every medium.

We collect chaos and call it beauty.

Machines make scale. People make taste. The interesting part of this company is not that it uses intelligence — most do now — it is that judgement still decides, and the judgement is recorded, argued with and allowed to be wrong.

01Project — build one thing.
02Campaign — one objective across the right mediums.
03System — infrastructure that keeps producing or operating.
04Partner — an external creative intelligence layer.
